# ui::Thickness

Header: `winui/core/Geometry.hpp`.

A per-edge thickness in DIPs, used for margins, paddings and border widths.

A number is the same value on every edge (`.margin = 8`). Other thicknesses name their edges, through [ui::Edges](edges.md) (`.margin = ui::Edges{.left = 32}`) or [ui::Symmetric](symmetric.md) (`.padding = ui::Symmetric{.horizontal = 16, .vertical = 8}`), so the code says which edge gets which value.

Example: 
```cpp
window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .margin   = ui::Symmetric{.horizontal = 24, .vertical = 12},
    .content  = {ui::Text{.text = "Indented", .margin = ui::Edges{.left = 16}}},
});
```

```cpp
float left = 0.0f
```

## Thickness

```cpp
constexpr Thickness() = default
```

All four edges 0.

## Thickness

```cpp
constexpr Thickness(float uniform)
```

The same value on all four edges, so a field takes `.margin = 8`.

## Thickness

```cpp
constexpr Thickness(const Edges& edges)
```

The edges `edges` names; the others 0.

## Thickness

```cpp
constexpr Thickness(const Symmetric& edges)
```

[`horizontal`](#horizontal) on the left and right, [`vertical`](#vertical) on the top and bottom.

## horizontal

```cpp
float horizontal() const
```

left + right: the width this thickness takes out of a rect.

## vertical

```cpp
float vertical() const
```

top + bottom: the height this thickness takes out of a rect.
